data.one_liner: OpenCV4 bindings for Dart/Flutter using ffi for native computer‑vision functions.
data.what_it_does: The package wraps OpenCV 4 modules and exposes them to Dart via ffi. It lets Flutter apps perform image processing, feature detection, DNN inference and other vision tasks with native performance.
use_when: You need advanced computer‑vision algorithms not available in pure‑Dart libraries
Cross‑platform (mobile/desktop) apps require high‑performance image processing
avoid_when: Targeting web only where native assets aren't supported
You prefer a lightweight pure‑Dart solution
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux
Hooks and code‑gen simplify native asset handling
weaknesses: Requires native build steps and CMake
data.setup_notes: Requires Dart SDK >=3.10, CMake, and native‑assets hooks configuration. May need to adjust deployment_target for iOS/macOS and ensure prebuilt binaries are available or build OpenCV yourself.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure‑Dart image manipulation library with no native build, suitable for simple processing and web support
